checks.detail: shifted_field.u is bit-identical to field.u; only spatial_limits move. shift_grid declares where the window sits, it does not translate the data -- which is why the upstream cell plots field.amplitude with a shifted extent rather than plotting shifted_field.
checks.name: shift_grid_relabels_coordinates_without_touching_the_field

checks.detail: output shape (1024, 1024) with mode='same' against the (1024, 1024) input -- the crop happens inside Chromatix, unlike mode='full'
checks.name: mode_same_returns_the_input_shape

checks.detail: Pearson r = 0.998428 between the modified-transfer-kernel and chirp-z amplitudes for the same displaced window: the two independent algorithms agree on where the light goes
checks.name: the_modified_kernel_and_the_czt_compute_the_same_structure

checks.detail: the CZT output is smaller by an amplitude factor of 1.2686 (power ratio 1.6127 = 1.2686^2), and even after removing that scale a 4.6% RMS residual remains. Nothing upstream or in the docstrings mentions a normalisation difference, so a consumer that treats use_czt=True as a drop-in alternative will be 27% off in amplitude.
checks.name: but_they_disagree_on_amplitude_normalisation

checks.detail: measured displacement matches lambda*|kykx|*z to 0.08% at all three sweep points, and misses |kykx|/(2*pi/lambda)*z by at least 528%. Measured 265.83, 532.30, 1063.15 against 266.00, 532.00, 1064.00 (frequency reading) and 42.34, 84.67, 169.34 (angular reading).
checks.name: asm_propagate_kykx_is_a_spatial_frequency_in_cycles_per_length

checks.detail: every sweep point used a NEGATIVE kykx_x and produced a POSITIVE displacement: kykx=-0.004589 -> +265.83, kykx=-0.009178 -> +532.30, kykx=-0.018356 -> +1063.15
checks.name: the_displacement_is_opposite_in_sign_to_kykx

checks.detail: plane_wave(kykx=0.0591) at lambda=0.532 displaces the beam 544.84 over z=108953.6, matching the ANGULAR reading 544.77 and not the frequency reading 3422.88. asm_propagate's kykx is the other way round. The two parameters share a name and differ by a factor of 2*pi/lambda vs lambda, i.e. 2*pi in the sin(theta) relation.
checks.name: the_two_kykx_conventions_differ_by_two_pi

checks.detail: power captured: untilted on-axis 0.9459, tilted on-axis 0.4986, tilted with the matching shift 0.9447, tilted with the opposite shift 0.0163. The correctly shifted window recovers as much as the untilted case; the on-axis window loses half the beam and the wrongly shifted one loses almost all of it. That is what off-axis propagation is for, stated as numbers.
checks.name: the_correctly_shifted_window_recovers_the_tilted_beam

demonstrates: chromatix.shift_grid, Field.spatial_limits, and asm_propagate(shift_yx=..., bandlimit=..., kykx=..., use_czt=..., output_dx=..., mode='same') for a laterally displaced output window.
title: Off-Axis Propagation
